metrics_definitions.range30: median across 27 complete nonoverlap 360-tick windows of (high-low)/window initial price; then equal seed mean
metrics_definitions.wallet_exhaustion: balance <= 1e-6, account-tick fraction including tick0 and final counts
metrics_definitions.below3: actual cash + foreign*marginal price <3; no production death status
metrics_definitions.attempt_ratios: clipped and skipped / order_attempts; no-intent / arrivals separately
metrics_definitions.vs_hodl: final wallet marginal MTM minus (5000+1000*same-path final price)
metrics_definitions.liquidation: per-account independent sale of all foreign into final pool plus cash; simultaneous aggregate sale separately; no realized PnL
metrics_definitions.shock_response: existing event_response 120 ticks, mean last12 closes relative instant shock; terminal excluded; 9 correlated events/path,3 independent seeds
metrics_definitions.returns: shock instant jump removed using pre-injection close; std and signed ACF1,12,60

limits: same seed is not paired endogenous price/intensity after divergence
